name: shared-worktree-build-concurrency
title: Crash-safe concurrent-build mutex + content-bound idempotent build (shared-worktree review pipeline)
description: Deferred from B-fb7b: crash-safe concurrent-build mutual exclusion + content-bound idempotent build for the shared-worktree review pipeline. Replace the hand-rolled mkdir mutex (age-steals a live holder; check-then-delete reclaim TOCTOU race) with a proven lockfile lib or OS-advisory lock, and replace mtime/existence freshness (misses deleted-source orphans, partial builds, tampered outputs) with a content-bound build-binding over source+config+deps+all outputs, adding a packages/utils binding. Codex MAJOR-1..4 recorded in the B-fb7b cross-host review.
